text_english: a reading according to saint john may his blessings be with us amen

text_english: glory be to god forever

text_english: note that the correct translation is glory to you o lord

text_english: and jesus went up to jerusalem and he found in the temple those who sold oxen and sheep and doves and the money changers doing business

text_english: with the sheep and the oxen and poured out the changers’ money and overturned the tables

text_english: and he said to those who sold doves “take these things away do not make my father’s house a house of merchandise ”
text_coptic_arabic: أووه بيجاف نني إت تي تشرومبي إيڤول جي أليوي نناي إيڤول تاي مبيرير بي مبايوت نو إي نشوت

text_english: then his disciples remembered that it was written “zeal for your house has eaten me up ”
text_coptic_arabic: آڤيرفميڤي نجي نيف ماثيتيس جي سسخيؤيت جي بكوه مبيكي فنااڤومت

text_english: the exposition of the sixth hour of monday of holy pascha may its blessings be with us amen

text_arabic: يا لهذه الجسارة التي صنعتها يا شعب اسرائيل اول ميلاد الله وهذه البلادة التي من كهنتك اذ موضع الغفران صار موضع الخطية
text_english: o israel god s first children what impudence did you commit and how insensitive are your priests the place of forgiveness became a place to sin

text_arabic: وبيت الصلاة وموضع الطلبة صيرتموه مسكنا للصوص ومكانا للعجول والخراف ولباعة الحمام والصيارف ما هو هذا الربح المملوء من كل نجس وهذا الظلم الذي صنعتموه
text_english: the house of prayer and place of supplication you have turned into a den of thieves a place for calves and sheep for sellers of doves and money changers what is this profit filled with every uncleanness and this injustice that you have done

text_arabic: لما نظر ابن الله بيت ابيه وهذه كلها تصنع فيه فانهم صيروه مسكنا للصوص الخاطفين والظلمة وبيتا للتجارة اخرج البقر والغنم ومعها كراسي باعة الحمام وموائد الصيارف قلبها وبدد دراهمهم
text_english: when the son of god looked upon his father’s house and saw all these things being done in it they had made it a dwelling place for robbers and evildoers and a house of trade he drove out the cattle and the sheep together with the seats of the dove sellers overturned the tables of the money changers and scattered their coins

text_arabic: فلما نظر تلاميذه هذا علموا انه هكذا هو مكتوب لاجله ان غيرة بيتك اكلتني فلهذا صنع هكذا بغير خوف
text_english: when his disciples saw this they knew that it was written concerning him “zeal for your house has consumed me ” therefore he did this without fear

text_arabic: سلطانك دائم في السماء وعلي الارض وخوفك يا رب زعزع الجبال اما اسرائيل فقد صار جاهلا فلذلك استترت عنه معونته
text_english: your reign endures in heaven and upon the earth and your fear o lord has shaken the mountains but israel has erred and thus was denied god s help

text_arabic: ختام الطرح
text_english: exposition conclusion

text_english: christ our savior

text_english: has come and has borne suffering

text_english: that through his passion
